verdict.rationale: Shared inboxes are a fair question for an email provider, so the axis applies. The pack has no Fastmail documentation of shared mailboxes, shared folders, delegated access or team channels with a common conversation state. The 'Logging in to multiple accounts' article and a community mention of 'family setup' describe adjacent account switching and plan management, not a shared team inbox. JMAP's multi-account session model is a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
